newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek depos, forwards dip, FRNs up, ecu/drs flat.
newsitem.headline: Greek depos, forwards dip, FRNs up, ecu/drs flat.

text.p: Greek depos and implied forward drachma rates from forex forwards were trading 10 to 30 basis points lower with the drop more accentuated in the short-end propping up FRNs and ecu/drachma was hovering around 307.5, dealers said.
"Depos are down 20 to 30 basis points up to one-month, 10 to 20 basis points from one-month to three-months and 10 basis points thereafter," said a dealer at a private bank.
Implied forward drachma rates in periods up to one-month were down a fifth of a point and a tenth of a point in longer tenors, the dealer said.
"The interest trend is pointing downwards helped by ample liquidity," the dealer said.
Lower interbank rates had boosted FRN prices because of the reduced cots of funding, bond dealers said.
"The cheaper cost of funding has certainly helped fuel a mini rally in FRN prices," said a senior bond dealer at a private bank. "I expect fixed coupon bonds to follow the trend soon."
The mark was quoted at 157.23/33 from Wednesday's 157.380 fix, the dollar at 271.30/40 drachmas from 271.270 and the ecu at 307.13/23 from 307.370 drachmas.
"It is quiet with very few deals so far and ecu/drachma is trading in the tight range 307.40/55," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank.
